## Who I am

Aleksandr Ivannikov — independent engineering studio of one + curated contractors. 13+ years of experience, 50+ shipped projects across 12+ countries. Started writing code in 2013 (initially in secure-communications systems for state agencies), transitioned to commercial software in 2016, moved into Web3 / blockchain in 2021, and now lead engineering for B2B SaaS, AI-native products, and Web3 systems — with proprietary AI orchestration tooling under the hood that helps deliver projects 2–3x faster than traditional agencies.

**Working principles**:
- Architecture before code. I do not start building before the business model and constraints are understood.
- Production-grade is the only mode. Everything ships with monitoring, error handling, CI/CD, and security review.
- AI tooling is a force multiplier, not a substitute for engineering judgment.
- Direct client communication. No PMs in the middle, no agency overhead.

**Location**: remote / global. Based out of Abu Dhabi (UAE) and Moscow.

**Languages**: Russian (native), English (fluent).

## Services

I structure engagements around outcomes, not hours. Engagement tiers below — discovery-driven scoping for each.

### 1. Strategic Consultation — from $250/hr
A 1-on-1 session to validate your architecture, tech stack, and engineering plan before you commit months of runway. You walk away with a clear roadmap, defined stack, and a strategy to reach MVP faster and cheaper. Best for: founders evaluating Web3, AI, or B2B SaaS architecture decisions.

### 2. AI Optimisation (NEW) — from $1,500 audit / $8,000+ implementation
Make your product cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI. I run a 26-criterion AI-readiness audit and execute the implementation: `llms.txt`, JSON-LD schema, per-page `.md` mirrors, OpenAPI cleanup, content rewrite under the CITABLE framework. Best for: B2B SaaS teams losing organic visibility to AI search.

### 3. AI Development: Agents & RAG — from $5,000
Custom AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and LLM-integrated product features. I architect either with commercial models (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) or self-hosted (Llama, Mistral) depending on privacy and latency. Best for: SaaS teams adding AI-native features, internal tooling, or customer-facing assistants.

### 4. Turnkey Product Development — from $5,000
Full product build, idea to production MVP in 8–12 weeks. UI/UX, smart contracts (if Web3), frontend, backend, deployment. I act as your technical co-founder and take ownership of the entire product lifecycle. Best for: founders without an in-house team who need a complete solution.

### 5. Smart Contract Development — from $3,000
Gas-optimised Solidity contracts for DeFi and tokenomics. Foundry-tested, internally pre-audited, designed to pass third-party audits on the first attempt. Best for: Web3 teams launching tokens, DEXs, NFT mints, or governance systems.

### 6. Telegram Bots & Mini Apps — from $4,000
Native Telegram bots (Telegraf v4+) and Mini Apps that tap into Telegram's 900M+ user base. Wallet integrations, payments, subscriptions, referrals. Best for: products targeting mass-adoption through Telegram funnel.

### 7. Mobile / Web Development — by scope
React, Next.js, modern web stacks. Frontend for dApps and SaaS products. Used as adjacent capability inside larger Turnkey engagements.

### 8. DeFi Protocol Forks — from $4,000
Custom forks of battle-tested protocols (Uniswap V2/V3, Curve, Synthetix, Compound) with your tokenomics and UI on any EVM chain. Best for: DEX launches in 2–3 weeks instead of 6 months from scratch.

### 9. Support & Maintenance — from $1,500/mo
Proactive monitoring, incident response, feature iteration for live Web3 / SaaS products. Uptime, security patches, scaling support.

### 10. Telegram Mini Apps Specialised — by scope
Deeper Mini App engagements, native TON integration, full back-end + database + Web App API.

## How I work (process)

I structure every project around four phases. Total duration depends on scope but transparency is consistent.

### Phase 1 — Discovery & Strategy (1–2 weeks)
Deep dive into your business goals. I do not ask "what features do you want"; I ask "what business outcome are we buying". I map user journeys, define technical requirements, choose the optimal architecture and stack. Deliverable: technical architecture document + roadmap.

### Phase 2 — Build (4–10 weeks)
Iterative development with weekly progress updates and continuous CI/CD. Access to staging environments throughout. No black boxes. Code quality enforced from day one.

### Phase 3 — Audit & Launch (1–2 weeks)
Security review (critical for Web3), thorough testing, third-party audit coordination if needed, smooth production deployment, release-cycle setup.

### Phase 4 — Scale & Support (ongoing or fixed retainer)
Monitoring, error tracking, scaling infrastructure, iterative improvements based on real-user feedback.

## Pricing methodology

Value-based, not hourly. Project cost typically equals 5–20% of the annual outcome value to the business — not the count of features delivered. For most engagements, this lands in:

- Strategic consult: $250/hr (entry tier, fast turnaround)
- AI-readiness audit: $1,500 fixed (12-page report + walk-through)
- Implementation projects (AI Optimisation, smart contracts, Turnkey MVP): $3,000–$15,000 depending on scope
- Larger Turnkey / multi-month builds: $10,000–$50,000
- Retainer (ongoing support, AI visibility tracking, content cadence): $1,500–$8,000/month

I do not work on hourly contracts and do not charge for change requests within the agreed outcome.

Wrong ICP (politely decline):

## Frequently asked

**Do you use AI to write the code?**
AI tooling is part of my workflow — including a proprietary orchestration platform I have built (`auto-dev`) for multi-agent delivery. Engineering judgment, architecture decisions, security review, and final code quality are mine. AI is the force multiplier, not the engineer.

**Can you work with our existing team?**
Yes. Many engagements are co-build with a client team — I take ownership of specific subsystems (smart contracts, AI features, architecture) and coordinate with your developers.

**What about NDAs / IP?**
Standard NDA at engagement start. All deliverables transfer to client ownership at project completion. I retain the right to mention the engagement in case studies subject to client approval.

**What if we need security / penetration testing?**
I do internal code review and can coordinate external audits with top-tier security firms (especially for Web3 smart contracts). Not a substitute for, but a complement to, formal audits.

**Refund / cancellation policy?**
Engagements are split into phases with clear deliverables. Either party can pause or terminate between phases. No refunds on completed phase deliverables.
